tool_task_training: only true tool-action training rows; separate prompt/prefill
inference: action first; tool task only when predicted action is tool; arguments and ownership validated separately
claim_limit: action-only runs cannot claim learned tool selection or model-generated arguments

pilot.sampling: uniform over nonempty train (action, capability_profile) strata, then uniform group, then uniform row; record actual coverage and repeats; no eval replay
pilot.extension: none without explicit successful development gate and a new recorded budget

development_gate.required_comparison: raw model results; backend guards and parameter grounding reported separately

calibration.usage: temperature and fallback thresholds only after development selects a candidate

final.usage: one fixed candidate versus same-prompt base after selection and calibration freeze

uncertainty: group resampling must cluster by macro_scene; each split has only eight macro stories, so confidence intervals and real-user generalization are limited
limitations: New eight-action contract is incompatible with V5 merged tool classes
No Jev comparison until separate API budget is authorized
